tools.name: tsx_list_securities
tools.description: List securities. Default 100 rows, max 1,000; truncated responses carry truncated=true + total. Free tier.

tools.name: tsx_get_security
tools.description: One security by id. Free tier.

tools.name: tsx_get_bars
tools.description: EOD bars for one security. Default 252 rows, standard cap 252; full history needs explicit history=full. Free tier.

tools.name: tsx_get_bars_by_date
tools.description: Bars for one date. Default 100 rows, max 1,000. Free tier.

tools.name: tsx_get_meta
tools.description: TSX service metadata (snapshot time, registry counts). Public: no key needed, not counted.
